name: imda-ai-governance
description: Agentic AI governance guidance for engineers designing, reviewing or changing AI agents — aligned with Singapore IMDA's Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI (v1.5), with IMDA's Model AI Governance Framework for Generative AI (2024) as a supplement.
